_meta.description: Hand-labelled Serbian businesses, used to measure classification precision. Every record is a real listing, extracted verbatim from a public Serbian business directory; nothing here is invented.
_meta.collection: One polite HTTP GET per category page, honest user agent, robots.txt checked first (portal-srbija.com: `Allow: /` with only /admin*/ and /pretraga/ disallowed; poslovnikontakt.com: `Disallow:` — empty). Public business-contact listings published by the businesses themselves. No logins, no CAPTCHAs, no phone numbers stored here.
_meta.why_these_categories: The category pages were chosen to be adversarial, not representative. `Termo izolacija` and `Čišćenje fasada` are the two categories where the words `termoizolacija` and `fasada` appear on companies that are not in our market at all, and `Završni radovi` is full of adjacent trades. 111 of 161 records are true negatives on purpose.

labelling_rubric.FACADE_CONTRACTOR: The record shows the business performing facade work: fasaderski radovi, demit/termo fasada, izrada/postavljanje/sanacija/restauracija/održavanje fasade, fasadne obloge. Washing or cleaning a facade does not count.
labelling_rubric.CONSTRUCTION_MATERIAL_STORE: The record shows the business selling building materials: stovarište, građevinski materijal, farbara, veleprodaja/maloprodaja, or a materials assortment wide enough that it can only be a yard.
labelling_rubric.BOTH: The record shows both, independently — a yard that also installs.
labelling_rubric.UNKNOWN: Everything else, including every business whose only facade/insulation wording belongs to another trade. A manufacturer is UNKNOWN: it is a supplier, not a buyer.
